qualifications: This integration combines current main8edcf953 with the reviewed ActiveJob/class-reflection/setter-symbol changes and the Array-index dispatch, marked forwarding keywords and Range cost follow-ups. Prior d1ce Mailer results are a separate
cohort; current-main runtime and CAPI changes are included. Each binary has its own fresh native installation.
A complete file is not necessarily all passing. Remaining REDs and every non-COMPLETE state are retained explicitly.
Only this exact frozen integration is measured. Native extensions were freshly installed by this measured binary; no prior native install reuse.
Per-file family bounds are 600 seconds and 2 GiB, jobs 2, fixed seed 12345. Full component runs are serial across this stream; all work used the shared two-slot Codex admission gate.

The full Mailer cohort uses only the opaque-class-addresses identity policy. The separate large-JSON resource controls use rails-argument-descriptions. Raw case inventories and actual policy fields are retained in each cohort.
External residuals remain in the raw counts and strict all_pass result; explicit predecessor policies allow only named cases linked to their issues. They do not mark those cases passing.
This cohort also includes the Array alias-arity and Range/three-Integer fast-path review corrections from PR406. It uses a separate new integration binary and a new native installation.

The previous v15 attempt failed in reference RubyGems startup before any Rails file discovery or test execution. That environmental failure remains preserved separately; it is not included as a test failure or a passing run.

rebuilt binary has its own SHA256 and every native gem for this cohort was freshly installed with it.
